race.comment: ZIP LOCK (2) resumes as the horse with the strongest exposed form, having won the G3 BJ McLachlan Stakes here before finishing sixth in the LR Magic Millions 2yo Classic when favourite. Two trials should have him forward enough, and he can make the perfect return. WARREGO RIVER (12) looks the sharpest danger after making an encouraging return here last time. Should appreciate stretching further second-up and gets in light for Moor, who sticks. ELEVATING (6) was a head away at this track first-up despite blundering at the start. With a cleaner getaway she can make her presence felt down in the weights. NIGHT MARKET (8) is progressive and is worth keeping in mind.
